correctness.rationale: For all real cyclic x,y, use the exact continuous piecewise-linear median-selector representation. On strict chambers P1=1; variations of arc indicators are extreme modulo constants because a zero-sum cyclic gradient decomposes into positive linear combinations of e_p-e_q. Thus each selector norm is the maximum number of connected components of its preimage of an arc. A 3-local selector creates at most three such components, at most two for n=4,5, and zero for n=3 because every window equals the whole 3-cycle. Explicit strict-order and arc witnesses realize 2 or 3 for every admissible n (n>=7 uniformly). Separately threshold coarea proves the one-input TV contraction, not the two-input result. Independently reconstructed all strict selectors and cyclic arcs for n=3..7, obtaining max 0,2,2,3,3, and checked unequal-total-variation attaining pairs n=4..7; finite checks do not establish the n>=8 bound.
